import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Flow {
        static final int N = 50 * 99 + 2;
        static final int M = 2 * N * 15 + N + 7;
        static int[] par = new int[N];
        static int[] first = new int[N];
        static int[] nxt = new int[2 * M];
        static int[] ep = new int[2 * M];
        static int m;
        static long[] flo = new long[2 * M];
        static long[] cap = new long[2 * M];
        static long[] cost = new long[2 * M];

        static void init() {
            m = 0;
            Arrays.fill(first, -1);
            Arrays.fill(flo, 0);
        }

        static void addEdge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
            nxt[m] = first[ep[m] = a];
            first[a] = m;
            cap[m] = c;
            cost[m] = p;
            ++m;
            nxt[m] = first[ep[m] = b];
            first[b] = m;
            cap[m] = 0;
            cost[m] = -p;
            ++m;
        }

        static int[] q = new int[N];
        static int[] inq = new int[N];
        static boolean[] vis = new boolean[N];
        static long[] pot = new long[N];
        static long[] dist = new long[N];

        static void mcfPotInit(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
            for (int k = 1; k < n; ++k) {
                for (int e = 0; e < m; ++e) {
                    if (cap[e] > 0) {
                        pot[ep[e ^ 1]] = Math.min(pot[ep[e ^ 1]], pot[ep[e]] + cost[e]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        static long mcfUpdate(int s, int t, long[] price, int n) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(inq, -1);
            int qs = 0;
            inq[q[qs++] = s] = 0;
            while (qs > 0) {
                int u = q[0];
                inq[u] = -1;
                q[0] = q[--qs];
                if (qs > 0) {
                    inq[q[0]] = 0;
                }
                for (int i = 0, j = 2 * i + 1, t; j < qs; i = j, j = 2 * i + 1) {
                    if (j + 1 < qs && dist[q[j + 1]] < dist[q[j]]) {
                        j++;
                    }
                    if (dist[q[j]] >= dist[q[i]]) {
                        break;
                    }
                    int temp = q[j];
                    q[j] = q[i];
                    q[i] = temp;
                    temp = inq[q[j]];
                    inq[q[j]] = inq[q[i]];
                    inq[q[i]] = temp;
                }
                if (vis[u]) {
                    continue;
                }
                vis[u] = true;
                for (int e = first[u]; e != -1; e = nxt[e]) {
                    int v = ep[e ^ 1];
                    if (flo[e] < cap[e] && dist[v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[v] + cost[e]) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[v] + cost[e];
                        par[v] = e;
                        if (inq[v] < 0) {
                            inq[q[qs] = v] = qs;
                            qs++;
                        }
                        for (int i = inq[v], j = (i - 1) / 2, t; dist[q[i]] < dist[q[j]]; i = j, j = (i - 1) / 2) {
                            int temp = q[i];
                            q[i] = q[j];
                            q[j] = temp;
                            temp = inq[q[i]];
                            inq[q[i]] = inq[q[j]];
                            inq[q[j]] = temp;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] >= Long.MAX_VALUE) {
                return 0;
            }
            long df = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int e, i = t; i != s; i = ep[e]) {
                e = par[i];
                df = Math.min(df, cap[e] - flo[e]);
            }
            for (int e, i = t; i != s; i = ep[e]) {
                e = par[i];
                flo[e] += df;
                flo[e ^ 1] -= df;
                price[0] += df * cost[e];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                pot[i] = Math.min(Long.MAX_VALUE, dist[i] + pot[i]);
            }
            return df;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        Flow.init();
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            Flow.addEdge(0, a, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < 99; t++) {
            Flow.addEdge(1 + t * n, n * t + n, Long.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    Flow.addEdge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, Long.MAX_VALUE, c);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < 15; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < 99; t++) {
                    Flow.addEdge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    Flow.addEdge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }
        Flow.mcfPotInit(Flow.N);
        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = 0;
        while (long df = Flow.mcfUpdate(0, n * 99 + n, price, Flow.N)) {
            flow += df;
        }
        assert (flow == k);
        pw.println(price[0]);
        pw.close();
    }
}
